metadata.name: Geochemical Sediment Core Analysis from SO268 Cruise Station SO268_043MUC
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical concentrations and enrichment factors for 16 elements (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) in shallow sediment sub-samples from Core 20 at Station SO268_043MUC. Includes raw concentrations (ppm), relative enrichment factors, and two variants of normalized concentrations and enrichment factors. All samples collected at a single deep-sea location in the eastern Pacific Ocean on 2019-03-10.
